rows.abstract: Proposes the following amendments to the Local Government Code in order to strengthen local autonomy: (1) Devolution of socialized housing programs; (2) investing in stock corporations and private enterprises; (3) authority to open/close roads in private subdivisions; (4) conduct of public hearings/consul tation prior to implementation of government projects.

rows.abstract: Authorizes LGUs to secure the services of consultants and contractual workers WITHOUT NEED OF SECURING PERMISSION from the national government and the CSC. Mayors can go on official travel by merely informing the Governor, provided the travel shallnot be more than 15 days.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 1998-09-28

rows.title_full: AN ACT ENHANCING FURTHER THE AUTONOMY OF LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991

The Sangguniang Bayan may prescribe reasonable guidelines to regulate such activities; (2) adopt measures to enhance the national agrarian reform program; and (3)regulate jeepney  and bus operations within the municipality.
